repurchase_cash.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
repurchase_cash.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

sbc.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
sbc.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

treasury_shares_acquired.label: Treasury Stock, Shares, Acquired
treasury_shares_acquired.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and are being held in treasury.

treasury_value_acquired.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
treasury_value_acquired.description: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

shares_issued.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
shares_issued.description: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

equity_raise_cash_flow.label: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity
equity_raise_cash_flow.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of common stock, preferred stock, treasury stock, stock options, and other types of equity.

plan_shares_issued.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
plan_shares_issued.description: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

treasury_shares_balance_alt.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Shares
treasury_shares_balance_alt.description: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

treasury_value_balance.label: Treasury Stock, Value
treasury_value_balance.description: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

net_income__0.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
net_income__0.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

net_income__1.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
net_income__1.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

net_income__2.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
net_income__2.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

diluted_eps__0.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
diluted_eps__0.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

wtd_diluted_shares__0.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
wtd_diluted_shares__0.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

operating_income__0.label: Operating Income (Loss)
operating_income__0.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

pretax_income__0.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
pretax_income__0.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

pretax_income__1.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
pretax_income__1.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

tax_provision__0.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
tax_provision__0.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

common_equity__0.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent
common_equity__0.description: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which are attributable to the parent. The amount of the economic entity's stockholders' equity attributable to the parent excludes the amount of stockholders' equity which is allocable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest). This excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

dividends__0.label: Payments of Dividends
dividends__0.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

financial_assets__0.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
financial_assets__0.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

total_debt_nc__0.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
total_debt_nc__0.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

ocf__0.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
ocf__0.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

shares_outstanding_dei.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
shares_outstanding_dei.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

divev__PaymentsOfDividends.label: Payments of Dividends
divev__PaymentsOfDividends.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

divev__CommonStockDividendsPerShareDecla.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
divev__CommonStockDividendsPerShareDecla.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

divev__CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashP.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
divev__CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashP.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.
